milestone: Package 11: commit-msg-check shipped; kit at 11 packages, 73 tests

package.name: dsh-commit-msg-check
package.decides: commit-message shape: type prefix from a known set, subject within the git-log wrap, no trailing period, blank line before the body, breaking changes in a trailer
package.distinct_rule: parses a single message file — no git history needed, so the same function serves a commit-msg hook and the HTTP route; a bang without a BREAKING CHANGE: trailer is a warn because downstream tooling parses the trailer, not the bang

design_note: started as a changelog-consistency package and dropped it: release-notes-check already covers version-heading ordering, so a second package on the same surface would be quantity without a new noun. Commit messages are a distinct surface (every commit, not every release) with a distinct audience (the commit-msg hook).
